name: Isshou ni Ichido Dake Saku Hana no Namae de
original_name: 一生に一度だけ咲く花の名前で
source:
Main character notices the silhouette of a tower in the blue sky. Some call it "Tower of flame heat". At the same time human body evaporation incidents start to occur on the streets. He meets a girl and unwillingly gets involved in a fight among three factions...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公注意到蓝天中一座塔的轮廓。有人称之为"焰热之塔"。与此同时，街上开始发生人体蒸发事件。他遇到了一个女孩，不情愿地卷入了三方势力的争斗中……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
